text: {"findings":[{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-014 ETA buffer experiment without referencing it","detail":"EXP-014 already tested a 10-minute buffer on promised windows. It raised On-Time Delivery Rate but reduced checkout conversion, and the gain came from relaxed promises rather than faster delivery. The proposal does not reference or learn from this result.","evidence_quote":"Give customers a more generous arrival range by adding 10 extra minutes of cushion in the three worst zones, to lift on-time rate.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-014-eta-buffer"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-014, explain what is different this time, and add checkout conversion as a guardrail. Judge the change on Promise Accuracy and conversion, not on OTD alone."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"No checkout conversion guardrail for a promise-window change","detail":"EXP-014 found that a promise-window buffer cut checkout conversion by 1.2% while OTD rose. The learning was to judge promise changes on Promise Accuracy and conversion. The guardrails list Promise Accuracy but omit conversion.","evidence_quote":"- Promise Accuracy: median error must not worsen.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-014-eta-buffer"],"recommendation":"Add checkout conversion with a numeric stop threshold as a guardrail. Also track Promise Accuracy P90, not only the median."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Zone-day switchback risks leakage between arms, and no sample size is given","detail":"Zone-day switchback assignment can carry over between periods, because customers see ranges across days and zones. No carryover or washout handling is described. Pre-registration requires a sample size or power basis, and the plan gives only an MDE and a power percentage. The MDE of 1.5 points is also well below the 4-point on-time lift targeted (86% to 90%).","evidence_quote":"Switchback by zone-day. Duration: 4 weeks. MDE: 1.5 points of on-time rate, power 80%.","citations":["experimentation-standards#pre-registration"],"recommendation":"Document the carryover and washout handling and the sample size calculation. State the stopping rule explicitly, and align the MDE with the target effect."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Concentration of late arrivals asserted without figures","detail":"The proposal says late arrivals are concentrated in a few zones and picks 'the three worst zones'. It cites only a dashboard view and gives no figures or share of late orders. Neither the zone selection nor the claim can be verified.","evidence_quote":"Late arrivals are concentrated in a few zones (source: LMD weekly dashboard, on-time view).","citations":[],"recommendation":"Quantify the share of late orders in the three zones, name them, and link the specific dashboard snapshot."}]}
